control.label: control
control.method: Frozen control 0b07410 versus per-cut archive completion, control first. Same per-reply eight-frame transport window, archive batch size two, four archive-cut slots, 256-MiB admission budget and 4096-entry cap. Three pinned 1-vCPU/3-GiB nodes, 1500 three-voter groups, 500 leaders/1000 followers each; four SQL workers/64 reservations; 24 writers, two 180-second windows. Fresh persistent internal node data and unchanged external RustFS backing, cold VM each cohort. No timed retries. Exact 4500 replicas/1500 archives, all errors retained. Boundary host/compiler/VM CPU observations. No builds, profiling or preservation by this task during timing. All artifacts retained; historical cohorts relocated with verified content/metadata and original volume paths before both runs.

method_limits: Control first; reversed confirmation remains outstanding.
Successful latencies exclude refused requests; any timed error fails qualification.
Operation durations overlap and are not additive client latency components.
Per-cut completion can precede its batch timer; the batch histogram measures the full joined owner and is not per-cut publication latency.
Boundary VM/cgroup counters differ in timing and cannot be exactly subtracted.
Coverage index distance includes protocol entries; boundary lag is not admission retained-entry count.

disposition.reason: No qualified end-to-end benefit; observed lower TPS and more retained-entry refusals. Unequal compiler overlap prevents causal attribution. Local regressions and frozen artifacts retained.
